# Daily Report — 2026-10-07

## Task Completed
Add `list_change_request_comments` tool — journal entries (comments and work notes) for change requests.

Queries the `sys_journal_field` table scoped to `name=change_request` and the change's `element_id`.
Accepts a CHG number (e.g. CHG0010001) or a 32-char sys_id via `_resolve_change_request_sys_id`.
Optional `entry_type` filter (`comments` / `work_notes`). Pagination with `has_more` / `next_offset`.
Response includes `comments` list (sys_id, type, value, created_on, created_by), `count`, `change_id`, and `message`.
Registered in `service_desk`, `change_coordinator`, and `full` packages.
